relation.note: D01744 was the maternal (milk-)uncle (خال) of Shams al-Dīn b. Ṭarṭūr al-Muqriʾ, being his mother's milk-brother (أخو أمه من الرضاع). Identified as AIND-D06995 (full biography, no. 240: محمد بن أحمد بن مهنا بن أحمد الشمس القاهري المقري، ويعرف بابن طرطور), confirmed by D06995's own text: Ibn Ṭarṭūr "memorized the Qurʾān and perfected it (jawwada) under a milk-brother of his mother named Shihāb al-Dīn al-Abshīhī" (= D01744) — the exact reciprocal. AIND-D12481 (ابن طرطور محمد بن أحمد بن مهنا) is the ابن-section cross-entry for the same person; D06995 is canonical.

al-Madūrī perfected recitation (jawwada) under D01744 in the riwāya of al-Sūsī over two complete readings (khatmatayn), as al-Sakhāwī was informed by D01744 himself; D01744 in turn did not know from whom he himself had read. al-Madūrī occurs only here in the corpus (no existing AIND). Provisional TMP-P-000622 retained (per Waka 2026-07-10: المدوري is a genuine name, not a miscopy of المذكور).

event.note: Resided in the vicinity of Jāmiʿ al-Ṭabbākh.

person.note: アフマド、ラカブはシハーブ、アル＝アブシーヒー、クルアーン読誦師（ムクリ）。アッ＝タッバーフ・モスク界隈に居住した。彼はシャムス・アッ＝ディーン・イブン・タルトゥール・アル＝ムクリの母方の（乳）叔父であった。というのも彼はイブン・タルトゥールの母の乳兄弟だったからである。彼（アフマド）が私（＝サハーウィー）に語ったところによれば、アル＝マドゥーリーが彼のもとでアッ＝スースィー伝によるクルアーン読誦を二度の通読（ハトマ）で完成させた。しかし彼（アフマド）自身は、誰から（読誦を）学んだのかは分からなかった。

Aḥmad, al-Shihāb al-Abshīhī, a Qurʾān reciter (muqriʾ), resided in the vicinity of Jāmiʿ al-Ṭabbākh. He was the maternal (milk-)uncle of Shams al-Dīn b. Ṭarṭūr al-Muqriʾ, because he was his mother's milk-brother. As he (Aḥmad) informed me (al-Sakhāwī), al-Madūrī perfected under him the recitation in the transmission of al-Sūsī over two complete readings. However, he (Aḥmad) himself did not know from whom he had received his own recitation.
